g.text: US-15: Scoped Alert Delivery - Server Filters Before Pushing
API maintains in-memory scope map for
Redis holds the entity's last known position.
Used to evaluate the geo_region bounds check.
If the entity is dark (key expired), last known
position from the alert payload is used instead.
geo: lat 48.8, lon 2.3 within France bounds? YES
geo: lat 48.8, lon 2.3 within Atlantic bounds? NO
FLT123 is over France, not the Atlantic.
Client-side filtering would have sent this
alert to Operator B and let the browser discard it.
